name: KTM 500 EXC-F / 350 EXC-F
engine: 350 or 510 cc liquid-cooled four-stroke single, fuel injected
intro: KTM's plated enduro four-strokes. Light, fast, and on an hour-based service schedule.

H: Four-stroke motocross engines need frequent valve checks and oil changes. Follow the hour-based schedule in the manual, not the calendar.

recallNote: KTM has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
